summary: Mouse hears a helicopter and answers his ringing cellular phone. Tank's voice warns him the hardline is cut and it is a trap. Mouse opens the curtain to find the windows bricked up. As he spins, the rumble of combat boots builds and explodes into the room.

what_changes.before: In the room, unaware of the exit status
what_changes.after: Trapped, as the windows are bricked up
Confronted by physical threat entering the room
what_changes.evidence: RUMBLE of combat BOOTS BUILDS, then explodes into the room.

event_hint.one_line: Mouse is trapped in Room 1313 as combat boots breach the door.
